sentences.text:
With
 Mac No.153/2023
 Branch Manager United India Insurance Co. Ltd. Versus Ramkhelawan
14.06.2024

Mr. Raj Awasthi, Counsel for the appellants in both the
 cases.
None for respondents No.2 and 3 in Cr No.24/2023.
Mr. N. S. Dhurandhar, Counsel for respondents No.1 to 5 in Mac No.153/2023.
Ms. Priya Kaiwart, Counsel for respondents No.6 & 7 in Mac No.153/2023.

Ms. Kaiwart prays for sometime to seek instruction and to file Vakalatnama for respondents No.2
and 3 in Cr No.24/2023.
Issue notice to respondent No.1 as per rules in Cr No.24/2023.
Heard on admission.

Shri Awasthi, learned counsel for the petitioner/Insurance Company in connection with Civil Revision No.24/2023 would submit that Section 173 (2) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 stipulates that no appeal shall lie against any award of a Claims Tribunal if the amount in dispute in the appeal is less than ten thousand rupees.

He would also submit that in the instant case the accident was occurred on 16.12.2019 and on 01.04.2022 by the amendment in the said section word "One Lac Rupees" was substituted in place of "Ten Thousand Rupees".
He submits that in the present case Rs.20,000/- as compensation was granted in favour of the non-applicant Ramsewak Singh in Claim Case 33/2020, hence appeal could not lie against such award.
Therefore, present revision has been filed.
In connection with MAC No.153/2023 he submits that in the same accident Mankunwar was died and therefore, her husband, son and daughters have preferred Claim Case No.28/2020.
In the said claim case an award for Rs.4,73,750/- has been passed on 30.09.2022.

He would also apprise this Court that in the said accident though liability was fastened upon the Insurance Company, however,
the offending vehicle was different as per criminal record.

He also submits that stay order has been Branch Manager United India Insurance ... vs Ramkhelawan on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149603545/
1 granted in favour of the appellant vide order dated 21.02.2023.

sentences.text:
In view of the aforesaid submission, this Court is of opinion that both the cases are arguable and thus both are admitted for hearing.
Registry is directed to not publish these cases under the heading of seems to be infructuous.
List this case after six weeks.
Meanwhile, call for the record of the Tribunal.

Sd/-
